ast09_ast_tr_unit , ast2.ast01_corp_id as ast09_corp_id , f_get_corp_nm(ast2.ast01_corp_id) as ast09_corp_nm , ast2.ast01_class_tree_nm as ast09_keep_account_nm , ast2.ast01_seq as ast09_keep_account_seq , f_get_corp_nm(ast2.ast01_corp_id) ||'('||f_ast_class_tree_nm(ast09_keep_account_id)||')' as ast09_keep_corp_account_nm , f_cdnm('ItemMClassCode',ast1.ast01_item_m_class_cd,ast09_company_id,ast09_hold_date) ||CASE WHEN substr(ast1.ast01_item_s_class_cd,5) = '99' THEN '' ELSE '('||f_cdnm('ItemSClassCode',ast1.ast01_item_s_class_cd,ast09_company_id,ast09_hold_date)||')' END as ast09_ast_class_nm , ast1.ast01_item_m_class_cd as ast09_ast_m_class_cd , f_cdnm('ItemMClassCode',ast1.ast01_item_m_class_cd,ast09_company_id,ast09_hold_date) as ast09_ast_m_class_nm , f_cdnm('ItemSClassCode',ast1.ast01_item_s_class_cd,ast09_company_id,ast09_hold_date) as COALESCE(ast12_real_qty,0) as ast09_real_amt , ast09_hold_qty - COALESCE(ast12_real_qty,0) as ast09_diff_amt , coalesce(( SELECT holdQty FROM ( SELECT ast09_hold_date holdDate , ast09_hold_qty holdQty FROM ast09_book WHERE ast09_company_id = book.ast09_company_id AND ast09_ast_class_tree_id = book.ast09_ast_class_tree_id AND ast09_keep_account_id = book.ast09_keep_account_id AND ast09_hold_date < #{holdDate} UNION ALL SELECT ast11_hold_date holdDate , ast11_hold_qty holdQty FROM ast11_book_close WHERE ast11_company_id = book.ast09_company_id AND ast11_ast_class_tree_id = book.ast09_ast_class_tree_id AND ast11_keep_account_id = book.ast09_keep_account_id AND ast11_hold_date < #{holdDate} ORDER BY holdDate DESC LIMIT 1 ) t),0) as ast09_preDay_amt , f_cdnm('LockUpPeriodCode', ast09_lock_up_period_cd, ast09_company_id, ast09_hold_date) as ast09_lock_up_period_nm , f_get_sellPossibleQty(ast09_book_id, #{holdDate}::date) as ast09_sell_possible_qty , COALESCE(ast09_lock_up_qty,0) as ast09_lock_up_qty , CASE WHEN ast09_lock_up_date IS NULL THEN ast09_first_pur_date ELSE f_get_biz_date2(0, ast09_lock_up_date, '+1', 'true') END as ast09_sell_possible_date , CASE WHEN COALESCE(ast09_eval_amt,0) = 0 THEN null ELSE trunc(ast09_eval_amt / f_nvl(ast09_hold_qty,1) * COALESCE(ast1.ast01_tr_unit,1),2) END as ast09_eval_price , trunc((ast09_eval_amt - ast09_book_amt) / f_nvl(ast09_book_amt,1) * 100,2) as ast09_ty_pl_rate , trunc((ast09_eval_amt - ast09_pur_amt ) / f_nvl(ast09_pur_amt ,1) * 100,2) as ast09_pur_pl_rate , CASE WHEN ast09_lock_up_date IS NOT NULL THEN f_get_datediff(f_get_biz_date2(0, ast09_lock_up_date, '+1', 'true'), #{holdDate}, '2') ELSE f_get_datediff(ast09_first_pur_date, #{holdDate}, '2') END as ast09_hold_period , CASE WHEN ast41_stop_loss_rate IS NULL THEN '정보없음' ELSE (CASE WHEN (ast09_eval_amt - ast09_pur_amt) / f_nvl(ast09_pur_amt,1) * 100 <= (ast41_stop_loss_rate * -1) THEN '매도필요' ELSE '' END) END as ast09_stop_loss_notice , CASE WHEN COALESCE(ast1.ast01_cur_cd,'KRW') = 'KRW' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE((SELECT ast24_apply_fx_rate FROM ast24_fx_rate WHERE ast24_fx_rate_type = '01' AND COALESCE(ast1.ast01_cur_cd,'KRW') = ast24_cur_cd ORDER BY ast24_std_date LIMIT 1) ,1) END as ast09_fx_rate , ( SELECT TRIM(ast02_value) FROM ast02_detail WHERE ast02_ast_class_tree_id = ast1.ast01_class_tree_id AND ast02_title = '계좌번호' AND COALESCE(ast02_use_yn,'false') = 'true' LIMIT 1 ) as ast09_account_no , book.* FROM book INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree ast1 ON ast1.ast01_class_tree_id = ast09_ast_class_tree_id INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree ast2 ON ast2.ast01_class_tree_id = ast09_keep_account_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT sys09_code.* FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code ON ( sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id AND sys09_company_id = 0 ) WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'ItemSClassCode' AND COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'false' ) sys ON sys09_code = ast1.ast01_item_s_class_cd LEFT OUTER JOIN ast12_book_real ON ( ast12_company_id = ast09_company_id AND ast12_hold_date = #{holdDate} AND ast12_ast_class_tree_id = ast09_ast_class_tree_id AND ast12_keep_account_id = ast09_keep_account_id ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ast41_invest_asset_type, ast41_stop_loss_rate FROM ast41_invest_limit WHERE ast41_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast41_start_date IN ( SELECT MAX(ast41_start_date) FROM ast41_invest_limit WHERE ast41_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast41_start_date <= #{holdDate} ) ) ast41 ON ast1.ast01_item_s_class_cd LIKE ast41_invest_asset_type WHERE COALESCE(ast09_book_end_yn,'false') != 'true' AND ast1.ast01_asset_type = '1' /* 1:고유자산 / 2:운용(펀드)자산 */ AND ( ( '1' = #{astType} AND /* 자산구분(1:예금) => 10:현금 및 예치금 */ ast1.ast01_item_l_class_cd = '10' ) OR ( '2' = #{astType} AND /* 자산구분(2:금융자산) => 20:증권 */ ast1.ast01_item_l_class_cd = '20' ) ) AND 'Y' = (CASE WHEN COALESCE(ast1.ast01_mat_date,'9999-12-31') < #{holdDate} AND ast09_hold_qty = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) AND 'Y' = (CASE WHEN COALESCE(ast1.ast01_use_yn,'false') != 'true' AND ast09_hold_qty = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) ) t WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(ast09_corp_nm,ast09_keep_account_nm,ast09_ast_class_tree_nm,ast09_ast_class_nm)) LIKE upper(#{searchText}) ORDER BY ast09_ast_m_class_cd, ast09_ast_s_class_seq, ast09_keep_account_seq
